"""裁剪联络表关键格并放大，供细节确认。"""
from PIL import Image
import os

SHEET_DIR = r"C:\Users\UserX\Downloads\剪辑\work\sheets"
OUT_DIR = r"C:\Users\UserX\Downloads\剪辑\work\map\crops"
os.makedirs(OUT_DIR, exist_ok=True)

def grid_cells(sheet_path):
    im = Image.open(sheet_path)
    W, H = im.size
    cw, ch = W / 4.0, H / 3.0
    cells = []
    for r in range(3):
        for c in range(4):
            box = (int(c * cw), int(r * ch), int((c + 1) * cw), int((r + 1) * ch))
            cells.append(im.crop(box))
    return cells, (cw, ch)

def make_group(sheet_name, indices, out_name, cell_w=920):
    cells, (cw, ch) = grid_cells(os.path.join(SHEET_DIR, sheet_name))
    scale = cell_w / cw
    cell_h = int(ch * scale)
    picks = [cells[i].resize((cell_w, cell_h), Image.LANCZOS) for i in indices]
    n = len(picks)
    cols = 2 if n > 2 else n
    rows = (n + cols - 1) // cols
    canvas = Image.new("RGB", (cols * cell_w, rows * cell_h), (20, 20, 20))
    for i, p in enumerate(picks):
        canvas.paste(p, ((i % cols) * cell_w, (i // cols) * cell_h))
    out = os.path.join(OUT_DIR, out_name)
    canvas.save(out)
    print(out, canvas.size)

def grab(t):
    cap.set(cv2.CAP_PROP_POS_MSEC, t * 1000.0)
    ok, fr = cap.read()
    if not ok:
        return None
    return Image.fromarray(cv2.cvtColor(fr, cv2.COLOR_BGR2RGB))


def strip(name, t0, t1, step, cell_w=760, cols=3):
    ts = []
    t = t0
    while t <= t1 + 1e-6:
        ts.append(round(t, 3))
        t += step
    picks = []
    for tt in ts:
        im = grab(tt)
        if im is None:
            continue
        w, h = im.size
        im = im.resize((cell_w, int(h * cell_w / w)), Image.LANCZOS)
        picks.append((tt, im))
    ch = picks[0][1].size[1]
    rows = (len(picks) + cols - 1) // cols
    canvas = Image.new("RGB", (cols * cell_w, rows * (ch + 22)), (12, 12, 12))
    d = ImageDraw.Draw(canvas)
    for i, (tt, p) in enumerate(picks):
        cx, cy = (i % cols) * cell_w, (i // cols) * (ch + 22)
        canvas.paste(p, (cx, cy + 22))
        d.rectangle([cx, cy, cx + cell_w, cy + 22], fill=(0, 0, 0))
        d.text((cx + 6, cy + 5), f"t={tt:.2f}s", fill=(0, 255, 120))
    out = os.path.join(OUT, name)
    canvas.save(out)
    print(out, canvas.size)

def grab(t):
    cap.set(cv2.CAP_PROP_POS_MSEC, t * 1000.0)
    ok, fr = cap.read()
    if not ok:
        return None
    return Image.fromarray(cv2.cvtColor(fr, cv2.COLOR_BGR2RGB))


def strip(name, t0, t1, step, cell_w=760, cols=3):
    ts = []
    t = t0
    while t <= t1 + 1e-6:
        ts.append(round(t, 3))
        t += step
    picks = []
    for tt in ts:
        im = grab(tt)
        if im is None:
            continue
        w, h = im.size
        im = im.resize((cell_w, int(h * cell_w / w)), Image.LANCZOS)
        picks.append((tt, im))
    ch = picks[0][1].size[1]
    rows = (len(picks) + cols - 1) // cols
    canvas = Image.new("RGB", (cols * cell_w, rows * (ch + 22)), (12, 12, 12))
    d = ImageDraw.Draw(canvas)
    for i, (tt, p) in enumerate(picks):
        cx, cy = (i % cols) * cell_w, (i // cols) * (ch + 22)
        canvas.paste(p, (cx, cy + 22))
        d.rectangle([cx, cy, cx + cell_w, cy + 22], fill=(0, 0, 0))
        d.text((cx + 6, cy + 5), f"t={tt:.2f}s", fill=(0, 255, 120))
    out = os.path.join(OUT, name)
    canvas.save(out)
    print(out, canvas.size)


def full(name, t, crop=None, target_w=1500):
    im = grab(t)
    if crop:
        im = im.crop(crop)
    w, h = im.size
    im = im.resize((target_w, int(h * target_w / w)), Image.LANCZOS)
    out = os.path.join(OUT, name)
    im.save(out)
    print(out, im.size)

"""机器区特写 + 挂上时刻条带。"""
import cv2
from PIL import Image, ImageDraw
import os

VID = r"C:\Users\UserX\Downloads\剪辑\原始素材.mp4"
OUT = r"C:\Users\UserX\Downloads\剪辑\work\map\crops_C"
cap = cv2.VideoCapture(VID)


def grab(t):
    cap.set(cv2.CAP_PROP_POS_MSEC, t * 1000.0)
    ok, fr = cap.read()
    if not ok:
        return None
    return Image.fromarray(cv2.cvtColor(fr, cv2.COLOR_BGR2RGB))


def full(name, t, crop=None, target_w=1400):
    im = grab(t)
    if im is None:
        return
    if crop:
        im = im.crop(crop)
    w, h = im.size
    im = im.resize((target_w, int(h * target_w / w)), Image.LANCZOS)
    out = os.path.join(OUT, name)
    im.save(out)
    print(out, im.size)


def strip(name, t0, t1, step, cell_w=640, cols=4, crop=None):
    ts = []
    t = t0
    while t <= t1 + 1e-6:
        ts.append(round(t, 3))
        t += step
    picks = []
    for tt in ts:
        im = grab(tt)
        if im is None:
            continue
        if crop:
            im = im.crop(crop)
        w, h = im.size
        im = im.resize((cell_w, int(h * cell_w / w)), Image.LANCZOS)
        picks.append((tt, im))
    ch = picks[0][1].size[1]
    rows = (len(picks) + cols - 1) // cols
    canvas = Image.new("RGB", (cols * cell_w, rows * (ch + 20)), (12, 12, 12))
    d = ImageDraw.Draw(canvas)
    for i, (tt, p) in enumerate(picks):
        cx, cy = (i % cols) * cell_w, (i // cols) * (ch + 20)
        canvas.paste(p, (cx, cy + 20))
        d.rectangle([cx, cy, cx + cell_w, cy + 20], fill=(0, 0, 0))
        d.text((cx + 6, cy + 4), f"t={tt:.2f}s", fill=(0, 255, 120))
    out = os.path.join(OUT, name)
    canvas.save(out)
    print(out, canvas.size)
